topics.topic: the Hampi stone chariot that looks like one solid rock but isn't
topics.title: India's Stone Chariot Isn't One Block -- It's a 500-Year-Old Trick

beat_timings.text: India's 500-year-old stone chariot looks like **one solid block** of granite. It isn't.
Vijayanagara sculptors built it from **separate granite pieces**, then hid every seam inside the decorative carving.
Still think it's **one solid block**? Say so in the comments -- I dare you.

topics.first_clip_tags: church, stone, castle, wall, carving, religion, ancient, tomb, archaeology, ruin, europe, medieval, cathedral, knight, history, relic, templar, germany, travel, tourism, munich, rome

sources.note: Official state tourism page: the chariot's granite blocks have joints hidden inside decorative carving, creating a monolithic illusion.
Independent heritage site corroborating the chariot's multi-block construction disguised as a single carved stone.
